operators.name: custom_sigmoid
semantics: Corresponds to reference statement: x = self.sigmoid(x)
Applies sigmoid activation elementwise: output = 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
Preserves input shape, dtype (float32), device and stride
Returns a new tensor with identical shape

operators.name: custom_relu
semantics: Corresponds to reference statement: x = self.relu(x)
Applies ReLU activation elementwise: output = max(0, x)
Preserves input shape, dtype (float32), device and stride
Returns a new tensor with identical shape

operators.name: custom_add_bias

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: [N, C, H, W] as in reference step

semantics: Corresponds to reference statement: x = x + self.bias
Adds bias tensor to x with broadcasting along channel dimension
bias has shape [C,1,1], broadcast to [N,C,H,W], so for each element at index (n,c,h,w) output = x[n,c,h,w] + bias[c,0,0]
Preserves input shape, dtype (float32), device and stride
Returns a new tensor with identical shape
Elementwise sigmoid activation applied to input tensor x
Output shape [16,3,2048,2048], dtype float32, device cuda:0
Value matches torch.sigmoid on corresponding float32 input
Elementwise ReLU activation applied to previous tensor x
Output shape [16,3,2048,2048], dtype float32, device cuda:0
Value matches torch.relu on corresponding float32 input
Adds bias of shape [3,1,1] to x with broadcasting across N,H,W dimensions
Output shape [16,3,2048,2048], dtype float32, device cuda:0
Equivalent to torch.add(x, bias) with implicit broadcasting
